ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 88% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the perimeter and trailing edges, creating a high-contrast binary distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border on the trailing edge. Discrete black mottling and irregular blobs are visible at the distal tips and proximal to the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.2 relative to the immediate lobe curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring irregular peak-to-valley pixel heights ranging from 5 to 25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory with a convex curve at the medial section transitioning to an upward concavity as the lobes extend toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters localized at the lower central region near the notch and along the inner margin of the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial surface of the right lobe, consistent with rake mark morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular black pigmentation and localized textural disruption on the far right distal tip, indicating previous tissue damage or dense parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A single isolated black pixel spot located in the lower-left central white field, approximately one-quarter of the distance from the notch to the left tip.
